name: Monochrome
avoid_for: Decks that need visual personality or color-led storytelling — the all-ink palette is intentionally austere
weak_cases: Many categorical series cannot rely on color; small light text needs intended-size inspection.
visual_signature: Light Jost, Lora insight/quote voice, mono metadata and hairlines instead of color.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Maintain sans/serif/mono role contrast with tested script-appropriate fonts; avoid assuming matching light weights.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
